messages:
lina_sales: OrionBank POC hitting intermittent 429s and a few auth failures after they cut traffic to our private slice. Procurement needs a short exec summary + provisional dedicated quote by Friday. Can we triage?

samir_eng: Any logs or request ids?

lina_sales: Customer pasted this: 
[2026-03-18T09:12:41Z] req=ob-102 status=429 route=/v1/chat pod=ri-pod-12 conn=403
[2026-03-18T09:12:42Z] req=ob-103 error=invalid_token message=signature mismatch

jo_sre: Sounds like two separate issues: pod hotspotting -> 429 and an auth key mismatch. infra-bot, pull pod metrics for ri-pod-12 09:00-09:20 UTC.

infra-bot: metrics: ri-pod-12 cpu=85% qps=950 conn=410 error_429=18% ; cluster avg qps/pod=260 ; runtime=ri-0.14.3

emma_se: For auth: ask them for a signed test token or JWKS endpoint. If they used their KMS, the JWKS pointer can be stale after rotation.

samir_eng: I'll run `ri verify-token` if they provide the signed token. Lina, can you ask them for a redacted token?

lina_sales: Asked and they sent a redacted token. Passing to samir.

samir_eng: Verified locally, signature mismatch. I also checked their private-config: jwks_url -> /.well-known/jwks-rotated.json (old). Sent them steps to point to current JWKS and redeploy.

jo_sre: Mitigation for 429: enabling connection rebalancer and temporary per-pod smoothing. I'll toggle rebalancer for 20m. infra-bot, run toggle.

infra-bot: toggle-config --cluster orion-poc --enable conn_rebalancer --duration 20m --owner jo_sre -> done

billing-bot: Quick provisional calc: Dedicated 3k reserved + 3k burst ~ $27,500/mo. Need expected POC length and avg RPS.

lina_sales: Customer requests 4-week POC, avg 800 RPS, peaks 1.5k. I'll confirm. Procurement also asked for SOC2 attestation date.

emma_se: SOC2 Type II completed 2025-11-05. I'll send attestation PDF and compliance portal link. Legal requires NDA addendum for any early-start exception.

samir_eng: After JWKS pointer update and rebalancer toggle, errors dropped to <1%. Customer redeployed and confirmed.

lina_sales: Great — I'll draft the exec summary and attach attestation + provisional quote. Thanks team :thumbsup:
